title: ¡Listo, Spanglish pal!
style: reggaeton pop rap, Spanglish hooks, 128 BPM, spoken rap cadence, male lead vocals, female harmony responses, group chant chorus, Latin trap drum grid, palm-muted bassline, brass stabs, tropical percussion, pop drop chorus, call-and-response hooks, bilingual educational anthem, summer party energy, punchy studio mix, chorus beat drops [Style of music: upbeat Miami Spanglish reggaeton pop rap fusion, 128 BPM, energetic male rapper with smooth female harmonies and group chants, Latin trap beats mixed with pop drops, fun educational math vibe, heavy bass, claps, brass hits, tropical percussion, feel-good summer Miami party energy, bilingual flow, catchy hooks, professional studio mix, math beat drops on every chorus]
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey amigo, tú ya sabes… Maths is easy, you already know!
Numbers everywhere, let’s make the rhythm flow!
Add, subtract, multiply – it’s all in the beat,
You already know maths – feel the heat!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes Maths, you already know!
Add es sumar, subtract es restar, ¡vamos let’s go!
Equation es ecuación, fraction es fracción,
Problem es problema – easy solution, no stress at all!
Multiply multiplicar, divide es dividir,
Percent es porcentaje, decimal is clear!
You use maths every day, in the street, in the store,
Tú ya sabes Maths – now sing it some more!

[Verse 1]
En la tienda the discount is porcentaje off,
Calculate the price, no problem, no cough.
Fraction of a pizza, half es medio, quarter es cuarto,
You already split it – maths is smart-o!
Plus más, minus menos, total is the sum,
Geometry in the city, shapes everywhere come!
Circle es círculo, triangle triángulo too,
You see the angles daily – it’s nothing new!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes Maths, you already know!
Add es sumar, subtract es restar, ¡vamos let’s go!
Equation es ecuación, fraction es fracción,
Problem es problema – easy solution, no stress at all!

[Verse 2]
Cooking in la cocina, recipe needs measurement,
Grams, liters, volume – pure entertainment.
Area of the room, perimeter around,
You measure every day without writing it down.
Probability in the game, chance es probabilidad,
Statistics in the news, you already understand!
Formula es fórmula, solution es solución,
You solve it in your head – that’s your super power, son!

[Bridge – half rap, half sung, beat drops]
Wait… you thought maths was hard? Nah, it’s rhythm and flow,
Music is maths – beats per minute, high and low.
From Miami streets to the classroom glow,
You already know numbers – watch the knowledge grow!
¡Sumar! ¡Restar! ¡Multiplicar! ¡Dividir!
Fractions, decimals, geometry – that’s the kid!

[Verse 3]
En el carro the speed is velocity,
Distance over time – simple, no anxiety.
Budget in el banco, interest es interés,
You calculate the savings, yes you already guess!
Graph es gráfico, data es información,
You read the charts daily with no hesitation.
Algebra in the playlist, patterns in the song,
Maths and music together – where you belong!

[Verse 4]
Geometry on the beach, waves in the ocean,
Symmetry in the palm trees, perfect motion.
Volume of the speaker, bass drop equation,
You feel the maths in every celebration.
No problema with the numbers in your life,
Important decisions, perfect calculation!
Flexible mind, possible dream come true,
You already know Maths – it’s all inside you!

[Chorus – bigger, full group vocals + claps]
Tú ya sabes Maths, you already know!
Add es sumar, subtract es restar, ¡vamos let’s go!
Equation es ecuación, fraction es fracción,
Problem es problema – easy solution, no stress at all!
Multiply multiplicar, divide es dividir,
Percent es porcentaje, decimal is clear!
¡Familia, numbers, beats, and more!
You know more Maths than you thought before!

[Outro – chant style, big drop + fade with crowd cheers]
Tú ya sabes Maths… you already know…
Numbers and music make the whole world flow!
¡Sumar! ¡Restar! ¡Ecuación! ¡Celebración!
You already know Maths – ¡eso es la verdad!
Tú ya sabes… tú ya sabes… Maths is easy, let’s go!
